Tiled at 1.73 m since review 2 of the M2 captures (2.0 m in review 1, 1.5 m in the spec): at 2.0 m it repeated in step with the gravel and the dry needles (both 2.0 m), and where those layers blend the repeats reinforced each other into one weave.
